scope: Complete recorded empty normal-10pt spreadsheet surfaces: twelve native sources and twenty-two complete-surface samples per locale, including live dirty/floating grid/header changes. Captions, full property/state/display matrices and full forms remain open.

nativeInputs.scope: Twelve measured normal-10pt empty spreadsheet sources on native ru/en: complete surfaces, 63x15 grid, numeric headers, selected cell, dimensions, ReadOnly/Enabled, border and ignored/omitted properties. Other fonts/properties/combinations/profiles and full forms remain open.

surface.glyphs: Fixed 11px numeric headers: selected first row/column bold, tabular 6px advances with no pair kerning.
surface.scope: Other fonts/properties/states/combinations, full forms and display profiles remain open.

nativeMetricsChangedAfterFreeze: Explanatory scope/acceptance metadata only; all XML, rows, dimensions and RGB hashes are unchanged.

implementation.dimensions: The seventh independently measured document-family consumer shares documentSurfaceMetrics. Default 500x243; Width20/Height5 gives 200x118, Width35/Height9 gives 350x218.
implementation.emptyCell: The selected first cell is 64x16: pale outline with a three-pixel right/bottom extension, white inset at (1,1) size60x12, and #edeff8 fill at (2,2) size58x10. This differs from a symmetric two-pixel outline.
implementation.grid: #e5e5e5 lines every63px horizontally and15px vertically. Grid paints after selection, including its border pixels.
implementation.headers: Numeric headers start at x35/y15. Columns are64x15 at63px steps; rows are35x16 at15px steps. A shared six-pixel nine-slice bevel uses338 grayscale samples; it stores no text or whole-widget bitmap. Corner overlap/order is reproduced.
implementation.text: The existing shared FreeType module/faces render11px header numbers, first row/column bold. All numeric characters use6px advances with no pair kerning; row11 is included. Column baseline13, row baseline11+15*row. Text composites separately rounded premultiplied foreground/background terms over the bevel, leaving the existing label compositor unchanged.
implementation.state: ReadOnly retains active border; Enabled=false uses #e8e8e8. The recorded empty-cell appearance remains unchanged.
implementation.propertySemantics: Native export removes BackColor. ShowGrid=false and ShowHeaders=false are omitted defaults, while true is retained and visibly changes the preview. Original requests and canonical bytes are stored separately.
implementation.scopeGate: Native paint requires Linux, normal calibrated document font metrics, DPR1 and zoom100. Canvas is bounded to4096px per dimension and4194304 outer pixels; other conditions use the existing approximate surface and localized notice. These limits need later large-document/performance work.

data.verificationContext: Host process namespace and working X11 display, require_escalated execution

nativeCloseAudit.note: The initial English capture/close shell ended with143; the owned session was separately stopped and closure verified in the host process/window inventory before Russian launch. The Russian session used a separate successful guarded stop and host verification. Sandbox /proc absence is not used as evidence.

remaining: Other spreadsheet properties, combined headers/grid/state/style settings, fonts, stretch/fraction/bound cases and view-scaling/scroll/selection modes.
Canvas limits/large documents, captions/full forms, typed applicability/computed inspector semantics, other surfaces and DPI/zoom; full Linux and Windows acceptance remain open.
